disposition_reason: Whole-paper review identifies an original input-to-neural-response fitting procedure in Methods Retinotopy: a fixed 200-kernel convolutional encoding model. This source-native reconstruction route warrants further recovery, but the original evaluated performance endpoint/panel, exact score and meaningful fixed-capacity comparison are unverified. A preprocessing optimizer alone cannot activate an improvement task. Figure 5 mouse learning and descriptive neural contrasts remain distinct; no artificial pretraining experiment or new held-out benchmark is asserted.

source_paper.title: Unsupervised pretraining in biological neural networks

evidence.locator: Methods: Retinotopy, steps 1-4; Extended Data Figure 1b,c
evidence.supports: Describes original neural-response encoding Fn(img)=an*(K convolved with img)(kn,xn,yn), 200 kernels of 13x13, reference-mouse fitting and mapping of imaging mice. Reviewed text and panels do not establish a numerical performance comparator.

evidence.locator: Results: Faster task learning after pretraining; Figure 5 and Extended Data 9; Methods: Coding direction and similarity index; Reward-prediction neurons
evidence.supports: Behavioral learning is an intervention in living mice. Coding and reward-neuron cross-validation estimate representations/activity; these are not an evaluated artificial pretraining learner.

Inspected utilities consume supplied retinotopy transforms and calculate neural/behavioral outcomes. They do not establish the complete reference-mouse encoding fit or a source performance-score replay.
Author release documents data-processing/intermediate-output and figure-plotting notebooks; source-native retinotopy training and scoring entry points remain unbound.

evidence.locator: Version 2 description and files manifest; DOI 10.25378/janelia.28811129.v2
evidence.supports: Versioned release supplies neural, behavior, retinotopy and dimensionality-reduction files. Metadata review does not bind the original natural-image stimulus set, reference mouse or encoding fit matrices; no array payload was read.

target.description: Recover the source-native retinotopy encoding fit of neural responses to natural images: Fn(img)=an*(K convolved with img)(kn,xn,yn), with positive amplitude an and each neuron's assigned kernel and spatial position. Treat resulting cross-mouse mapping as the original downstream use, not an invented decoder task.

dataset.description: The source describes approximately 5,000 natural images for the reference fit and at least 500 images repeated three times for imaging-mouse mapping. Exact image identities, response arrays, reference dataset version and their binding to Figshare v2 are unresolved.

cohort.description: Recover the original reference mouse and complete imaging-mouse/eligible-neuron populations used for the retinotopy procedure. No reference identity, cell exclusion denominator or full original mapping cohort is authenticated by the reviewed metadata.

split.description: Retinotopy describes fitting and subsequent application but no explicit predictive train/test evaluation protocol. Exact original image/repeat membership remains unbound. Preserve any recovered original fit-sample comparison; introducing held-out images, mice or trials would be a separately labelled extension.

inputs.description: Source inputs are natural images, corresponding single-neuron responses, and tissue positions for downstream map alignment. Reference fit learns the kernels; imaging-mouse mapping uses these kernels to assign neuronal receptive-field positions. Do not replace them with texture-task labels or behavioral outcomes.

preprocessing.description: Reference images shown at 120x480 are downsampled to 30x120. Preserve K shape 200x13x13, positive amplitudes and original parameterization. The described alternating fit selects correlated kernel/position matches, updates aligned filters and recenters filter mass; downstream map alignment is a separate operation.

metric.description: Source describes correlation-based matching during fitting, but an evaluated reconstruction statistic, exact formula/normalization, numeric comparison and scored panel are not established. Do not assume a held-out R-squared, invent a loss, or treat lower internal optimizer cost as a paper-performance win.

aggregation.description: Original score aggregation over reference images/repeats, neurons and mapping mice is not specified as an evaluated performance endpoint. Retain every original eligible observation and distinguish fit quality from map alignment; no convenient neuron subset or new pooled score is admitted.

comparison.primary_metric: Original fixed-capacity retinotopy neural-response reconstruction endpoint, if an evaluated source comparison can be recovered

published_baseline.description: No original evaluated encoding score or comparative panel is verified. The paper shows learned filters and maps and describes fitting; these do not supply a numerical performance baseline. First determine whether the paper reports an ordered evaluation at all.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Source-native fit replay requires the exact reference mouse, stimuli/responses, fitting code/settings and original scoring procedure. Re-running a newly authored fitting loss would not resolve the absent source evaluation.

minimum_effect.rationale: The original score and scale, meaningful fixed-capacity comparison, and variation are unrecovered. No performance margin can be justified from convergence of a preprocessing optimizer or from biological effect sizes.

uncertainty.method: After recovering an evaluated source endpoint, predeclare uncertainty that respects repeated images/trials, neurons nested within mice and any stochastic fit variation. A fit-sample comparison must be reported as such; it does not establish out-of-sample generalization.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Unresolved original reference/mapping-mouse structure; images/repeats and neurons have distinct dependence
uncertainty.rationale: The source mapping cohort and scored sampling units are not authenticated. Filter initializations and neurons cannot be silently counted as independent animals.

paper_win_requires: First establish that the original paper evaluates an ordered retinotopy reconstruction/estimation endpoint, identify its exact panel/statistic and baseline, and verify that a meaningful fixed-capacity method comparison exists.
Recover the original reference mouse, image/repeat identities, full eligible cell populations, fitting conditions and exact score aggregation. Source description alone is not evaluator readiness.

Preserve the original 200 kernels of 13x13, source response parameterization, image processing and complete source evaluation cases; additional kernels, easier subsets or extra inputs cannot create a same-task win.
Reproduce the source-author method and original evaluated score before comparing a frozen candidate under justified effect and uncertainty requirements.

Do not invent a held-out split to supply a missing paper benchmark. Any new image-, trial- or mouse-held-out prediction evaluation is an extension; original fit-sample results must be described with their limited scope.
Do not count a lower unvalidated preprocessing loss, more favorable map, larger biological learning effect or stronger significance as surpassing the paper.
If further source recovery confirms that no ordered performance evaluation exists, reclassify this route as ineligible rather than manufacture a benchmark.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison is claimed; the original evaluated task and baseline remain unresolved.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive pending source recovery and confirmation of an evaluated original endpoint. If admitted later, iterate within the original source fit conditions and fixed capacity with explicitly budgeted feedback; do not silently create a generalization task.
episode.candidate_freeze: Before any admitted comparison, freeze model capacity, source-compatible fit algorithm, preprocessing, initialization/selection policy and complete evaluation manifest. The original fitting/evaluation boundaries must first be recovered.
episode.final_evaluation: No active final evaluator exists for this route. A future owner evaluation must compare candidate and author method on the same original scored data and metric, clearly identifying any fit-sample limitation. New holdouts are extensions.
episode.baseline_policy: Published evaluated score, reproduced author fit and current SOTA are separate. Existing biological-contrast evaluators calibrate reconstruction only; neither a locally defined loss nor a new held-out benchmark substitutes for an original source score.

blocking_issues: Determine whether the original paper reports an ordered retinotopy performance evaluation at all; Methods optimization and Extended Data 1 filter/maps alone do not activate a benchmark.
Recover the exact evaluated score, formula, normalization, original comparator and meaningful comparison at fixed 200-kernel capacity.
Bind original reference mouse, natural-image identities, repeats, complete eligible neuronal cohort and encoding-response arrays to versioned public inputs.
Recover source-native retinotopy fitting and scoring entry points, initialization/update/stopping details, original model-selection policy and aggregation.
Before activation, justify effect and dependent-unit uncertainty, declare concrete access/resource budgets and validate source replay; do not add a holdout to conceal a missing original evaluation.

legacy.notes: Preserve initial-evaluator-v1 and descriptive selectivity/reward/lick materials. Whole-paper recovery now tracks the unresolved original retinotopy fit as a possible source-native route. It does not assert an artificial pretraining experiment, an evaluated predictive benchmark or a same-task success from existing biological contrasts.
